kvozianov-skill-freshness-root.description: Use this skill first whenever the user asks about the health of their installed agent skills: auditing, checking, cleaning up, updating or de-duplicating skills in ~/.claude/skills, ~/.codex/skills, ~/.agents/skills or plugin folders, or finding skills that are broken (missing CLI or script), outdated versus upstream, duplicated across agents, or made redundant by built-in features like /loop or /schedule. Do not inspect skill folders by hand: this skill ships a scanner that covers every agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode, Antigravity), maps which agent loads…
kvozianov-skill-freshness-root.author: Kirill Vozianov
